```{r}
df = read.csv("../data/forecast_dataset.csv")
```

```{r}
val_start  <- as.Date("2021-01-01")
test_start <- as.Date("2023-01-01")
```

```{r historical average}
n <- length(df$close_usd_per_troy_oz)
r <- df$close_usd_per_troy_oz
ytar <- c(r[-1], NA)
U  <- which(!is.na(ytar))
X  <- as.matrix(df[U, ]); y <- ytar[U]; dts <- df$date[U]
y <- ytar[U]
dts <- df$date
TARGET <- "raw"

Nu    <- length(y)
ha    <- c(NA, cumsum(y)[-Nu] / seq_len(Nu - 1))
val_idx  <- which(dts >= val_start & dts < test_start); test_idx <- which(dts >= test_start)
ev_idx   <- c(val_idx, test_idx)                         # contiguous validation + test origins
cat(sprintf("Target: %s | ", if (TARGET == "raw") "raw gold log return" else "gold excess return"))
cat(sprintf("Origins %s -> %s | N=%d | p=%d | train %d | val %d | test %d\n", dts[1], dts[length(dts)], length(y), ncol(X), val_idx[1] - 1, length(val_idx), length(test_idx)))
```
